column2: (3) A bill of sale referred to in subsection (1) which is not
registered under the Secured Transactions Act, No.    of 2019
prior to the expiration of two years from the date of coming
into operation of this Act, shall  become legally unenforceable
after the expiration of such period.

4.

and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
